objectives_fil: Sa residenteng humihingi ng tulong, matanong ang pangangailangan, maituro ang angkop na health worker at malinaw na susunod na hakbang, manatili sa loob ng pagsasanay, at masabi ang follow-up ayon sa tagubilin ng health team.
objectives_en: Given a resident seeking help, ask about the need, identify an appropriate health worker and clear next step, stay within training, and state the follow-up directed by the health team.

sections.takeaway_fil: Maaaring unang lapitan ang BHW; katuwang siya ng midwife at health team.
sections.takeaway_en: A BHW may be the first contact and works with the midwife and health team.

sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig at linawin ang pangangailangan bago gumabay.
sections.takeaway_en: Listen and clarify the need before guiding someone.

sections.takeaway_fil: Mga halimbawa lamang ang paunang serbisyo; sundin ang pagsasanay, lokal na patakaran, at pangangasiwa.
sections.takeaway_en: Initial services are examples; follow training, local policy, and supervision.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin kung sino ang lalapitan at ipaliwanag ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm whom to approach and explain a clear next step.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin kung ano, kailan, at kanino mag-uulat ayon sa health team.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm what to report, when, and to whom under the health team’s instructions.

sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig, manatili sa saklaw, gumabay, at mag-follow-up kasama ang health team.
sections.takeaway_en: Listen, stay within scope, guide, and follow through with the health team.

check.prompt_fil: Tinanong ni Aling Nena si Riza kung anong gamot ang ibibigay sa anak niya. Hindi saklaw ng pagsasanay ni Riza ang pagbibigay ng payong iyon. Ano ang pinakamainam niyang gawin?
check.prompt_en: Aling Nena asks Riza what medicine to give her child. Giving that advice is outside Riza's training. What is her best response?

options.fil: Magmungkahi ng gamot batay sa karaniwang ginagawa ng kapitbahay.
options.en: Suggest a medicine based on what neighbors usually do.

options.fil: Sabihing pumunta sa health center at tapusin na ang usapan.
options.en: Tell her to go to the health center and end the conversation.

options.fil: Makinig, humingi ng gabay sa health team, ipaliwanag ang susunod na hakbang, at kumpirmahin ang follow-up.
options.en: Listen, seek health-team guidance, explain the next step, and confirm the follow-up.

check.feedback_fil: Hindi nagbibigay si Riza ng payong lampas sa kanyang pagsasanay. Tinutulungan niya si Aling Nena na makausap ang angkop na health worker at sinusunod ang tagubilin ng team sa follow-up.
check.feedback_en: Riza does not give advice beyond her training. She helps Aling Nena reach the appropriate health worker and follows the team’s follow-up instructions.
